subtitle: Turn long videos into concise, meaningful highlights.
privacy: Everything runs locally. Your videos are not uploaded to third-party AI services.

common.confirmDeleteCompleted: Delete every completed job and its files? This cannot be undone.

upload.formats: MP4, MOV, MKV, AVI, WebM, M4V · up to 8 videos in one highlight

config.maxSequenceHint: Hard maximum for any single continuous clip. Longer moments are cut to the most important part. Shorter clips stay shorter.
config.minSequenceHint: Optional floor for a single clip when the source moment is long enough. Leave empty in Auto to use the default (1.5s).
config.minSequenceCustomHint: Each clip stays at least this long when the source moment allows it.
config.sequenceAutoHint: Clip length follows the content. A hook can be 2s; an important explanation or action can stay 8–12s or longer if cutting would lose meaning. Set a minimum below only if you need longer clips.
config.prioritiesHint: Choose what the editor should prefer. Balanced keeps a mix. Select more than one and use the sliders to weight them.
config.allowRepeatHint: When off, the same idea, action, or visual is selected only once. Unique moments are preferred.
config.maxRepeatHint: Hard maximum for total repeated content when repeats are allowed. Shorter is acceptable; this is never a target.
config.cropHint: Only the selected area is used for scene detection, transcription, AI analysis, and highlight generation. The original files stay unchanged. The same crop is applied to every uploaded video.
config.customFocus: What should the final video focus on?

localAi.notice: Local models are not ready. Highlights still run with basic scoring.

settings.measured: Measured while a model was loaded
settings.detected: Detected from this computer. Run a test to confirm.
settings.visualHint: Turn this off for a faster pass that skips scene descriptions.
settings.ollamaUrlHint: Leave this at localhost when Ollama runs on this computer. Docker users point it at the host.
settings.timeoutHint: How long one model call may run before it is treated as failed.
settings.retriesHint: Extra attempts after a failed model call.
settings.batchHint: How many scenes are sent together. Lower this on a CPU or a small GPU.
settings.visionCtxHint: Context length for scene descriptions. Lower values use less memory.
settings.threadsHint: Threads used when a model runs on the CPU.
settings.whisperDeviceHint: Auto uses an NVIDIA GPU when CUDA is available. CPU is the safe choice on AMD, Intel, and Apple machines.
settings.helpIntro: Ollama reads scenes and the transcript. Whisper writes the transcript. FFmpeg cuts and encodes the video. Nothing is uploaded to a cloud AI service.
settings.helpCpu: CPU-only: install Ollama, leave the URL at localhost, and keep the recommended smaller models. Highlights still finish. Vision and transcription take longer.
settings.helpGpu: GPU: install the graphics driver, then install Ollama on the computer that has the GPU. Run Test local AI and check that it says GPU. In Docker, set the Ollama URL to the host. The app container does not need the GPU for models.
settings.helpAmd: AMD: if the test stays on CPU, restart Ollama with OLLAMA_VULKAN=1.
settings.helpTrouble: If FFmpeg is missing, install it and put it on PATH. If Docker cannot reach Ollama, use host.docker.internal or a LAN address. If a model is missing, install it here. If memory runs out, choose the next smaller model. If a GPU is listed and the test still says CPU, check the driver or use a smaller model.
